g.text: Tide wall hazard VFX prompt: a moving wall of dark seawater
advancing across the night-combat arena every 40 seconds, semi-
transparent deep-teal body with sea-glass foam crest, brass particle
glints, 2-3 s advance. To be built as Unity particles + shader (a
rendered video is not a real-time game effect); this prompt is for
concept reference frames only, the real-time effect must be authored
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
